name: Al Hoceima
hero_subtitle: Where the Rif mountains meet the Mediterranean — cliff-backed coves, golden urban beaches and a national park of sea and limestone cliffs.

info.best_time_val: May – Oct beaches · spring/autumn for hiking
info.vibe_val: Mediterranean bay, cliffs, relaxed Rif coast

overview.title: Welcome to Al Hoceima — Mediterranean Rif, cliffs and clear water
overview.p1: Al Hoceima sits on Morocco’s northern Mediterranean coast, where the Rif mountains fall into turquoise coves and sandy bays. This is not desert or Atlantic shore: limestone cliffs, fishing ports and a national park of land and sea define the place.
overview.p2: Most stays revolve around Quemado Beach in town, quieter coves like Cala Bonita, family sand at Sfiha, and outings into Al Hoceima National Park toward Cala Iris, the watchtowers of Torres de Alcalá and the wide sweep of Bades Bay.
overview.p3: Three to five days work well: beach time near the centre, one park-coast day, and evenings on the port corniche. Summer is for swimming; spring and autumn suit cliff walks with milder heat.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-day plan for Al Hoceima
itinerary.subtitle: Town beaches first, then park coast and a quieter bay.

day1.title: Quemado & town
day1.desc: Arrive, settle, swim at Quemado and evening on the corniche.

day2.title: Coves & Sfiha
day2.desc: Cala Bonita in the morning, Sfiha Beach in the afternoon.

day3.title: Park coast
day3.desc: Cala Iris or Torres de Alcalá, optional Bades Bay.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Transfer from Al Hoceima Airport (AHU) or by road; check in near the bay.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Main urban beach for a first swim and orientation of the bay.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Promenade and simple seafood near the harbour.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Sheltered cove for clear-water swimming closer to the cliffs.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Wider sand, family atmosphere, views toward the Peñón.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Corniche walk or a quiet café back in the centre.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Park shoreline: fishing village cove or watchtower trails.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Wider bay and historic Badis setting if time allows.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Sunset light on the cliffs before departure or another night.

q1.question: How many days in Al Hoceima?
q1.answer: Three days cover Quemado, one or two nearby coves and a park-coast outing. Five days allow a slower pace plus Bades Bay and Torres de Alcalá.

q2.question: Is Al Hoceima only for beach holidays?
q2.answer: Beaches are the main draw in summer, but the national park, cliff trails and fishing villages add walking and scenery beyond the sand.

q3.question: How do I get to Al Hoceima?
q3.answer: Fly into Al Hoceima Airport (AHU) or arrive by road across the Rif. Domestic flights link from major Moroccan cities in season.

q4.question: Best time to visit?
q4.answer: May to October for swimming and beach weather. Spring and autumn are better for hiking the park coast with less heat.
